primitives.name: Instantaneous rule interpretation advantage
primitives.verbatim_quote: The practitioner in court who can quickly interpret a law bearing on the case that is being tried has an instant advantage over his slower opponent who is, for the moment, mystified.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'Rule Comprehension': 'Dimensionless skill metric (0,1)', 'Interpretation Latency': 'Time in seconds', 'Advantage': 'Dimensionless performance boost'}
primitives.assumptions: Linear scaling; opponent's ignorance assumed constant.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Latency approaches zero recovers perfect advantage; infinite latency yields no edge.

primitives.name: Rule mastery prerequisite for football greatness
primitives.verbatim_quote: Correspondingly, no man can be a great football player unless he is an adept at the rules of the game.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'Rule Mastery': 'Dimensionless proficiency score (0,1)', 'Alpha': 'Positive exponent capturing diminishing returns'}
primitives.assumptions: Monotonic increasing relationship; threshold effect below which performance plateaus.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Rule Mastery → 0 yields minimal performance; Rule Mastery → ∞ shows bounded greatness due to physical limits.

layer2.mapping: Conformal prediction set for feasible strategy profiles: mastery defines the boundary of admissible actions.

primitives.name: Structured weekly rule review protocol
primitives.verbatim_quote: Urge the men at the next "Rule Quiz" to bring out some new feature under the rules.
primitives.assumptions: Regular reinforcement prevents knowledge decay; active contribution drives deeper learning.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Zero engagement leads to rule obsolescence; excessive focus crowds out practical skills.

layer2.mapping: Situational awareness state machine transitions: quiz participation updates belief states about rule nuances.
layer2.telemetry: Number of unique rule interpretations surfaced per session versus subsequent game compliance rates.

primitives.name: Captain and quarterback rule expertise requirement
primitives.verbatim_quote: Above all others, these men should know the rules correctly and perfectly.
primitives.assumptions: Leadership decisions cascade; errors compound linearly with play complexity.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Perfect knowledge yields optimal leadership; any mistake introduces systematic bias.

layer2.mapping: Game-theoretic equilibrium: captains/quarterbacks operate as information focal points, requiring flawless rule knowledge to coordinate team actions.
layer2.telemetry: Decision accuracy of captains/quarterbacks during high-pressure downs compared to team-wide success metrics.
